Description.name: Rare Jam Boree
Description.description: A decade has passed, full of musical craze; We've all grown together through this Monstrous phase.  Upon the Shanty, Seasonals all sing carefree... But still were surprised to meet Rare Jam Boree!  With a Roamin' candle placed on its Chokkolitty top, Everyone knows that the music won't stop.  Sparklers for cheer, and candles burning bright, For all Singing Monsters, there's no end in sight!
